values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/roundlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Round Lake State Forest Campground, Otsego: rustic, open all year, Otsego Lake SP 989-732-5485, 10 sites, $20, carry-in access C, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/roundlake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 10 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/roundlake ('There are 10 sites for tent and small trailer use.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (10 campsites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Campground roads may not be plowed in winter.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Round Lake State Forest Campground, Otsego: 'Seasonal closure dates' 'open all year'; '*Please note: SFCG campground roads may not be plowed in the winter.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground in Pigeon River Country State Forest, 14 miles east of Vanderbilt via Sturgeon Valley Road and Round Lake Road, along the shoreline of Round Lake; access to the High Country Pathway, and the Pigeon River (brown, brook and rainbow trout) is a mile west. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 10 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 'tent and small trailer use' is the standard SFC wording (silent on length). Season changed: derived 'not year-round' (from the note's 'Open spring-fall') -> year-round per the amenity table ('open all year', roads may not be plowed). Type 'rustic', not equestrian; no ORV-trail-camp wording. No road warning on the page. Pin ~190 m from the DNR's directions point (45.134431, -84.453357). Note trimmed of field restatements and 'Open spring-fall'.
